# UPER

> Public education services and information about learning Chinese and studying in China. This directory links to source pages; it does not guarantee admission, scholarships, assessment outcomes or AI search inclusion.

## Public sources
- [About UPER](https://uperedu.com/about): Organization and services.
- [University and scholarship guidance](https://uperedu.com/consultancy): Application support and scholarship information.
- [Chinese courses](https://uperedu.com/hsk): Courses and preparation support.
- [CSCA preparation](https://uperedu.com/csca): Preparation services.
- [Study tours](https://uperedu.com/tours): Study visits and activities.
- [Partners](https://uperedu.com/partners): Featured universities and schools.
- [News](https://uperedu.com/news): Published articles, with their original content and dates.
- [FAQ](https://uperedu.com/faq): Answers to common questions.
- [Contact](https://uperedu.com/contact): Current contact details.
- [Careers](https://uperedu.com/careers): Current vacancies and requirements.

## Languages and scope
Public interface languages: Indonesian (default), English (?lang=en), Chinese (?lang=zh). Original published articles are not automatically translated. Refer to each source for current facts. This optional directory is not an indexing protocol or access-control mechanism. Internal staff workspaces and personal consultation content are outside its scope.
